profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | Python | Django | Odoo | e-CF | Managed ERP Platform | Automation + BI Platforms | Fast go-live, predictable pricing, reliable operations
profile.summary:
I’m a Senior Software Engineer at Geobritech. Right now, I’m focused on two things:
• Delivering reliable ERP, workflow automation, and BI platforms for SMB and mid-market teams
• Joining strong engineering teams where I can design, build, and scale production systems

I have 15+ years of experience in software engineering across multiple industries, building systems that connect cloud infrastructure, databases, and analytics/BI to real business outcomes. I’m comfortable owning projects end-to-end: from understanding business requirements, to designing the architecture, implementing features, and keeping systems running in production.

Through Geobritech, I’ve worked on managed business platforms that help teams modernize operations without the cost, risk, or long timelines of traditional ERP programs. Our work includes:
• Production-grade cloud architectures
• Security and access control
• Monitoring and alerting
• Backups, disaster recovery, and performance tuning
• Ongoing operations and support for mission-critical systems

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
A) Leaderboard game stats: I developed a real-time leaderboard of the best players of each game by events,
using WebSockets, Redis, and PostgreSQL, with this new feature, players can see their stats in real-time
compared to other players.
B) Admin CMS: To classify businesses that requested access to the platform, the administration could deny or
activate business accounts.
C) GraphQL API: I developed a middleware GraphQL API to serve documents by creating a mapping connection between the S3 Bucket and the API to enhance security.
D) SwaggerHub API: I successfully integrated SwaggerHub API with the Django Admin section. This integration streamlined our API documentation and testing workflows, providing a unified interface for managing API endpoints and ensuring consistency across our development and administrative operations.
E) Performance: I was in charge of profiling API services using memory_profiler, line_profiler, and cProfile,
which significantly enhanced our ability to identify performance bottlenecks.
F) Software Security: I implemented HMAC (Hash-based Message Authentication Code) for request validation. This approach ensures that all API requests are authenticated and authorized, protecting our system against
tampering and replay attacks.
G) End-to-End Encryption: I designed and implemented end-to-end data encryption for all WebSocket API communications, ensuring that data transmitted between clients and the server remains confidential and secure. 
H) Outcomes: Players were able to see their stats in real-time. Security improvement, fast API Response. The
administration can allow, block, and deny business accounts.
positions.insights: Skills: Python · Django REST Framework · Django · Wagtail · WebSocket · PostgreSQL · Amazon Web Services (AWS)

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
** Issues resolved:
A) I led the development of a CRM using Odoo, Python, Vue, GraphQL, and PostgreSQL for Attorneys and Medical Facilities, integrating features such as Google Maps for client assignments, Uber API for ride requests, and communication tools like email and SMS, leading to the consolidation of sales, dispatch, and customer service departments into a single Customer Service unit.
B) I developed a real-time KPI dashboard, including a Workload module, enabling agents, supervisors, and managers to access KPIs, document management, reports, client portfolios, shifts, notifications, and time attendance, facilitating fair distribution of bonuses based on employee performance.
C) I develop an integration for a Fingerprint device with the Time Attendance company's ERP system using Kotlin and Spring Framework. This integration enables HR to monitor employee arrivals in real time and generate reports, facilitating efficient workforce management.
D) I developed an integration between a Fingerprint device and the internal company's Point of Sale (POS) with C++. This integration was designed to seamlessly incorporate biometric authentication into the POS workflow, enhancing security, efficiency, and employee experience. One notable aspect of this integration was implementing a complete report functionality for employees and accounting who share the same fingerprint across multiple devices within the company's network.

** My responsibilities included: 
-- Make decisions regarding the software area.
-- Database management(MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, Redis)
-- Software architecture.
-- DevOps, build, release and run with Docker & Docker swarm.
-- Google Cloud Management.
-- Linux (Debian).
-- Control Version with Git & Bitbucket.
-- API Services (REST, GraphQL with Hasura).
-- WebSocket (NodeJs & Apollo).
-- Frontend Development(Vue, NuxtJs, JavaScript)
-- Backend Development(Python, NodeJs, Cython, Kotlin/Spring)
-- Odoo Development.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
** Issues resolved:
A) Timely Order Dispatch: The optimized system ensured prompt order dispatch, eliminating previous processing delays. This enhancement significantly bolstered overall customer satisfaction.
B) Efficient Printing: I successfully reduced the printing time for each order to less than 1 second, a remarkable improvement from over a minute. This efficiency boost streamlined the printing process, enabling quicker handling of high-order volumes. 
C) Operational Optimization: A more efficient workflow for generating invoices and purchase orders. This optimization not only mitigated operational bottlenecks but also fostered a more responsive and agile business process.

** My responsibilities included:
-- Software Infrastructure(Docker, Docker Compose, Nginx)
-- Database management(MySql, PostgreSQL)
-- Git & Bitbucket.
-- Backend development (Python/Django & DRF).
-- Odoo development.
-- Linux.
